audit_result.proof_trace: The property requires UNIQUE(display_name) on member.members, but no UNIQUE constraint exists at the DB level in any migration (0000_create_member_schema.sql:24 defines `display_name TEXT NOT NULL`; 20260317000000_add_display_name_and_rpc.sql adds it as plain `text`). The application write path (user.service.ts:updateUserDisplayName L124-133) also performs no duplicate check before UPDATE. The RLS policy allows any authenticated user to UPDATE their own row, including display_name, without restriction.
audit_result.attack_scenario: An authenticated club member updates their own member.members.display_name to match another member's name via the Supabase client (permitted by the self-update RLS policy). When the attacker scans their NFC card, the kiosk calls record_attendance_by_card RPC which reads the stored display_name and the kiosk screen (kiosk/page.tsx:305) displays the victim's name in large text to all observers, enabling kiosk-display impersonation.

PROP-e5782b58-inv-015.text: Display_name must be unique across members.users to prevent impersonation.
PROP-e5782b58-inv-015.assertion: forall INSERT/UPDATE members.users: UNIQUE(display_name) constraint enforced
